name: Hertz
verdict: Hertz is the car-rental brand of Nasdaq-listed Hertz Global Holdings, whose largest stockholder is CK Amarillo LP (57.6%), managed by the US investment firms Knighthead and Certares Opportunities. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Title partner in the Cadillac Hertz Team JOTA team name; 'Hertz Racing Gold' is a Hertz sub-brand (hertz.com/us/en/racing-gold). CK Amarillo LP, Knighthead Capital Management and Certares Opportunities are US private investment vehicles; the 2026 proxy names no state or sovereign-fund holder among its disclosed large stockholders. Quick company check (2026-10-03): the widely reported wrongful-arrest claims against Hertz ended in a settlement (about $168 million, December 2022) without a court finding, which METHOD.md excludes; no other court, regulator, UN body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Hertz from the last 20 years identified that meets the test.
